H1893.name: Abel
H1893.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H1893.brief: Adam and Eve's second son, killed by Cain
H1893.short: Abel, the second son of Adam and Eve, was a shepherd who was killed by his brother Cain.

H1813.name: Dalphon
H1813.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1813.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
H1813.short: Dalphon was one of the ten sons of Haman who were killed and hanged.

H1835H.name: Dan
H1835H.desc: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1835H.brief: Fifth son of Jacob, founder of Israelite tribe
H1835H.short: Dan was the fifth son of Jacob and the founder of the Israelite tribe bearing his name.

H1840G.name: Daniel
H1840G.desc: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
H1840G.brief: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions
H1840G.short: Daniel, also called Belteshazzar, was a prophet in Babylon known for his wisdom, integrity, and interpretation of dreams and visions.

H1841G.name: Daniel
H1841G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1841G.brief: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile
H1841G.short: Daniel, a priest, was among those who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H1873.name: Dara
H1873.brief: Son of Zerah, grandson of Judah
H1873.short: Dara was a son of Zerah and grandson of Judah.

H1862.name: Darda
H1862.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1862.brief: Wise man surpassed by Solomon's wisdom
H1862.short: Darda was a wise man, but Solomon's wisdom surpassed his.

H1867I.name: Darius
H1867I.desc: Ruler living at the time of Exile and Return
H1867I.brief: Mede who became Emperor over Babylon
H1867I.short: Darius the Mede received the Empire of Babylon and ruled over it.

H1867H.name: Darius
H1867H.desc: Emperor Darius I, 'the Great', living at the time of Exile and Return
H1867H.brief: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple
H1867H.short: Darius, king of Persia, issued a decree allowing the rebuilding of the Temple in Jerusalem.

H1867G.name: Darius
H1867G.desc: Emperor living at the time of Exile and Return
H1867G.brief: Persian Emperor during the time of the Levites
H1867G.short: Darius the Persian was the Emperor during the days of the Levites Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua.

H1874.name: Darkon
H1874.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1874.brief: Ancestor of a family of temple servants
H1874.short: Darkon was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H1885.name: Dathan
H1885.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1885.brief: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron
H1885.short: Dathan, a Reubenite, joined Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron and was punished by God.

H1857.name: Deker
H1857.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1857.brief: Son of Abinadab, one of Solomon's twelve officers
H1857.short: Ben-Deker was one of Solomon's twelve officers in charge of providing food for the king and his household.

H1806H.name: Delaiah
H1806H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1806H.brief: Priest in charge of the twenty-third division
H1806H.short: Delaiah was a priest appointed by David to be in charge of the twenty-third division of the priestly order.

H1806G.name: Delaiah
H1806G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1806G.short: Delaiah was a descendant of David through Jeconiah, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants.

H1806I.name: Delaiah
H1806I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1806I.brief: Ancestor of a family that returned from exile
H1806I.short: Delaiah was an ancestor of a priestly family that returned from the Babylonian exile but could not prove their genealogy.

H1806K.name: Delaiah
H1806K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1806K.short: Delaiah, the son of Shemaiah, was an official during King Jehoiakim's reign who heard Baruch read Jeremiah's scroll.

H1806J.name: Delaiah
H1806J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1806J.brief: Father of Shemaiah, who tried to deceive Nehemiah
H1806J.short: Delaiah was the father of Shemaiah, who tried to deceive Nehemiah into hiding in the temple.

H1807.name: Delilah
H1807.short: Delilah was a Philistine woman who deceived Samson into revealing the secret of his strength, leading to his capture.

H1845.name: Deuel
H1845.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1845.brief: Father of Eliasaph, leader of the tribe of Gad
H1845.short: Deuel, also called Reuel, was the father of Eliasaph, who was the leader of the tribe of Gad during the wilderness journey.

H1853.name: Diklah
H1853.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1853.short: Diklah was a descendant of Shem through Joktan, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H1896.name: Hegai
H1896.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1896.brief: A eunuch in charge of King Ahasuerus' harem.
H1896.short: Hegai was a eunuch in charge of King Ahasuerus' harem, responsible for preparing Esther for her night with the king.

H1834.name: Damascus
H1834.brief: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.
H1834.short: Damascus, an ancient city in Syria, played a significant role in biblical history.

H1835G.name: Dan
H1835G.brief: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.
H1835G.short: Dan, an Israelite tribe and a city in northern Israel, formerly called Laish or Leshem.

H1837.name: Dannah
H1837.brief: A city in the hill country of Judah.
H1837.short: Dannah, a city located in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:49">Joshua 15:49</ref>).

H1810.name: Dilean
H1810.brief: A city in the lowlands of Judah.
H1810.short: Dilean, a city located in the lowlands of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:38">Joshua 15:38</ref>).

H1829.name: Dimnah
H1829.brief: A Levitical city in the territory of Zebulun.
H1829.short: Dimnah, also known as Rimmon or Rimmono, was a Levitical city in the territory of Zebulun.

H1838.name: Dinhabah
H1838.brief: The capital city of Edom during Bela's reign.
H1838.short: Dinhabah, the capital city of Edom during the reign of King Bela (<ref="Genesis 36:32; 1Ch.1.43">Genesis 36:32; 1Ch.1.43</ref>).

H1850.name: Dophkah
H1850.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.
H1850.short: Dophkah, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings after leaving Egypt (<ref="Numbers 33:12-13">Numbers 33:12-13</ref>).

H1886.name: Dothan
H1886.brief: A place where Joseph found his brothers and was sold.
H1886.short: Dothan, a place where Joseph found his brothers and was later sold into slavery (<ref="Genesis 37:17">Genesis 37:17</ref>).

H1870H.name: Way of Holiness
H1870H.brief: A prophesied highway for the redeemed in Isaiah
H1870H.short: The Way of Holiness, a prophesied highway in Isaiah, reserved for the redeemed and leading to Zion (<ref="Isa. 35:8">Isa. 35:8</ref>).
